content.text:
Resubmitted with the minimality defect repaired.

**What changed:** the redline now touches only the two phrases needed for the fallback checklist — "TRUELINK'S" → "EITHER PARTY'S" and the carve-out parenthetical (adding indemnification and confidentiality alongside the existing gross negligence and wilful misconduct, made mutual and expressly "NOT SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION"). The existing scope words "SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT" are restored verbatim, so the Customer-favourable narrowness of the cap's reach is preserved, and the 12-month hosting-and-support fee basis is mapped as already met rather than re-drafted. Any cross-reference issue with Sections 3, 4 and 11 is left for a separate correction, and the preferred-level items (including the Client payment-obligations carve-out) remain available if the team escalates.
